boundary: Flooded vs dry along the Manu River, Moulvibazar, 9-12 July 2026. The Manu embankment breached at Uzirpur/Haripasha (Tengra union, Rajnagar upazila) on 9-10 July. Moulvibazar town sits behind the town embankment: the river ran 55-84 cm above danger level at Chandnighat, but only parts of Ward 1 were reported submerged. The Dhalai breach at Mokhabil (Islampur union, Kamalganj), the Kulaura breach at Shikoria (Prithimpasha union) and the Khowai breach (Habiganj) are all outside the 30 km radar box.

items.title: Manu embankment breaks at Uzirpur; villages of Tengra union go under
items.place: Uzirpur / Haripasha, Tengra union, Rajnagar upazila, Moulvibazar (union-level location)
items.what_it_shows: Story (no located photo). A 40-50 m section of the Manu embankment gave way on the afternoon of Thursday 9 July. Water flooded Uzirpur, Kandirkul, Ekamadhu, Haripasha, Ganeshpur and Akua, leaving about 5,000 people marooned (Ajker Patrika); later reports put it at 71 villages and about 40,000 people in Rajnagar. Ashraf Ali, 70, of Akua in Tengra union, was swept away and drowned early on Friday 10 July (bdnews24).
items.credit: Ajker Patrika (Bengali); also bdnews24 https://bdnews24.com/bangladesh/6ab2a50a67a0 and Daily Country Today https://www.dailycountrytodaybd.com/story/embankment-breaches-put-100-villages-underwater-in-m%27bazar;-50,000-marooned
items.notes: Event facts are high confidence: three outlets agree on the breach at Uzirpur, Tengra union, Rajnagar on the Manu. The location is low confidence: Uzirpur, Haripasha and Akua are not in OSM or Nominatim, so the coordinate is the Tengra union centre from bn.wikipedia (টেংরা ইউনিয়ন), roughly 1.5-3 km from the actual breach. The OSM Manu centreline runs through the union at about 24.485-24.50N, 91.86-91.91E. Some sources spell it Uazirpur or Uzipur. bdnews24 carries three flood photos (2026-07-10), not geolocated: https://media.assettype.com/bdnews24-english/2026-09-08/iw75hbki/moulvibazar_flood_100726_02_1783674940.jpg, .../4oiary0u/moulvibazar_flood_100726_03_1783675267.jpg, .../cihobh92/moulvibazar_flood_100726_04_1783675282.jpg

items.title: Defaloura and Rajnagar town: on the flood's edge, under threat but not reported flooded
items.place: Defaloura Eidgah, Rajnagar town (Tengra union edge), Rajnagar upazila
items.what_it_shows: Story. Daily Country Today lists Defaloura, Bhangarhat, Ganeshpur, Akua and others as villages that 'remain under severe flood threat', separate from the 71 villages already submerged by the Uzirpur/Haripasha breaches. Water had reached the top of the embankment at Bhangarhat.
items.notes: Location is good: OSM names দেফলউরা ঈদগা (Defaloura Eidgah) at 24.5183,91.8737, beside Tengra Govt Primary School (24.5167,91.880). 'Under threat' does not prove it stayed dry. Ganeshpur and Akua appear both in the 'threat' list and, in other reports, among flooded villages, so treat this as the flood's edge rather than confirmed dry. There is no photo.

items.title: Moulvibazar town holds behind its embankment as the Manu runs up to 84 cm above danger
items.place: Chowmuhona (town centre), Moulvibazar municipality; Chandnighat gauge on the Manu
items.what_it_shows: Story. The Water Development Board recorded the Manu 55 cm above danger level at Chandnighat and the Railway Bridge on 9 July, 71 cm on 10 July, and 84 cm on 11 July. Despite this, only 'parts of Ward 1 in Moulvibazar town' were reported submerged. The worst flooding was a government Ashrayan housing project on the riverbank in Sadar upazila (100+ houses, 200+ people moved to schools and onto the embankment).
items.credit: The Daily Star (9 Jul 2026); Daily Country Today https://dailycountrytodaybd.com/story/embankment-breaches-along-manu-river-:-40-villages-flooded-in-moulvibazar; bdnews24
items.notes: Town-centre coordinate from OSM (চৌমোহনা / Chowmuhona). 'Town protected by embankment' is my inference: the river was far above danger and only Ward 1 was reported flooded. No article states it outright. Ward 1 and the Ashrayan project are not geolocated, so I have not placed them. The Daily Star story has 'Photo: Star' images, captioned only 'Flash floods inundated several villages in Moulvibazar' (not located). The Chandnighat union centre (bn.wikipedia, 24.5094,91.7472) also shows no water change.

items.title: Kamarchak: water spills over the dam at Ward 2
items.place: Kamarchak union, Rajnagar upazila (south bank of the Manu, opposite Tengra; union-level location)
items.what_it_shows: Story. 'Overflowing water over the dam at Ward 2 of Kamarchak Union threatens to submerge adjacent settlements at any moment' (9-10 July).
items.credit: SK Sirajul Islam Siraj, Daily Country Today
items.notes: Coordinate is the Kamarchak union centre from bn.wikipedia (কামারচাক ইউনিয়ন); Ward 2 itself is not located. The source says 'threatens', so there is no confirmed inundation report for this exact spot.
